_readme: Registry of hand-built signature property pages. Each entry is a static folder at the repo root (e.g. /villa-mariposa/). This file drives the /signature/ gallery, the sitemap, and the Showcases tab in admin. To add/change a page, edit this file and the folder together, then push. status: live (gallery + sitemap), sold (gallery with SOLD badge + sitemap), hidden (URL still works, excluded from gallery and sitemap).
